title: Automation outputs go to review by default (S)
description:
Procedure outputs must not publish on their own by default. They land in review queues or Proposals unless the automation opts in to direct publish.

Scope:
- The run contract routes a procedure's outputs to a review queue or a Proposal by default.
- Opt-in to direct publish is per site and per automation, stored on the Automation record, and off by default.
- The opt-in is shown in the console (see the Automation page story).
- Any output touching pages still takes the projection lease and never reconciles.

Acceptance criteria:
- An automation with default settings never publishes directly; its outputs appear in review or as Proposals.
- An automation opted in at both site and automation level may publish directly; opting in at only one level does not.
- The opt-in state is visible to console users.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required.

Depends on PPY-433383 and the automation records story.
